rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a toilet or toilet room.

example.english: I need to go to the toilet.

rows.note: Use this softer term when you mean the bathroom or washroom as a room rather than the fixture.

example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 jau5 mou5 sai2 sau2 gaan1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the toilet fixture or bowl, especially when it is blocked or broken.

example.english: The toilet is blocked; can you take a look?
example.jyutping: maa5 tung2 sak1 zo2 nei5 bong1 ngo5 tai2 haa5
